source:
@@U00945@@
Here it’s bright, There brighter to sight. I’m alive! Watch out! Take care, my boy! This is no toy! It’s made of clay And will crumble away!

@@U00947@@
Why the sieve?

@@U00949@@
(Taking it down.)

@@U00950@@
If you were a thief, I could tell without grief. (He scampers over to the FEMALE MONKEY and makes her look through it.) See through the sieve! You know the thief well, Though his name you wont tell!

@@U00952@@
(Going to the fire.)

@@U00953@@
And this pot?

@@U00955@@
The crack-brained sot Knows not the pot, Knows not the kettle!

@@U00957@@
Discourteous beasts!

@@U00959@@
Here, take this whisk! Sit down on the settle! (He makes 梅菲斯特 sit down. 浮士德 in the meantime has been standing in front of a mirror, now approaching it, now drawing back.)
translation:
@@U00945@@
这里明亮，那里更明亮。我还活着！当心！保重，我的孩子！这不是玩具！它是用粘土做的，会碎掉！

@@U00947@@
为什么要用筛子？

@@U00949@@
（把它拿下来。）

@@U00950@@
如果你是小偷，我可以毫不悲伤地辨别出来。 （他跑到母猴身边，让她透过筛子看。）透过筛子看！你很了解这个小偷，虽然你不肯说出他的名字！

@@U00952@@
（走向火边。）

@@U00953@@
还有这个锅？

@@U00955@@
傻瓜不认识锅，不认识水壶！

@@U00957@@
无礼的畜生！

@@U00959@@
来，拿着这个搅拌器！坐下来吧！ （他让梅菲斯特坐下。与此同时，浮士德一直站在镜子前，时而靠近，时而后退。）
